groups.defect: Storage-failure branches in Create (line 45) and Update (line 129) call recordLegacyDuration instead of recordStorageDuration, so storage failures are counted against the legacy metric.
DeleteCollection's legacy goroutine (line 166) records its result with recordStorageDuration instead of recordLegacyDuration.
Create and Update pass a literal true instead of the actual result to recordLegacyDuration on the storage error path.

answer.reasoning: Two different mistakes exist. (1) In Create and Update, the storage error path uses the legacy helper. (2) In DeleteCollection, the legacy goroutine uses the storage helper. They run in opposite directions at different places, and each needs its own fix; one find-and-replace would not fix both. That makes them separate defects, not a single systemic pattern. s_fdf78d6e and s_7dc5b2ce do not object to the helper choice. They say the literal true should be the actual result, and their fix keeps recordLegacyDuration. That is a different defect on the same lines, repeated in Create and Update. Where to draw these boundaries is a judgment call.
